slot_scores.name: training_capacity_per_jet
slot_scores.evidence_quote: What is the exact rule linking jets allocated to training in a given year to the number of pilots trained (for example, how many trained pilots does one training jet produce per year, and does a jet in training produce pilots in the same year it is allocated or only in the following year)?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked how many trained pilots one training jet produces per year, directly covering the per-jet training capacity.

slot_scores.name: pilot_to_combat_jet_mapping
slot_scores.rationale: The agent did not ask how many combat jets a trained pilot can operate or otherwise clarify the pilot-to-combat-jet mapping.

slot_scores.name: training_duration_and_start
slot_scores.evidence_quote: does a jet in training produce pilots in the same year it is allocated or only in the following year?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent touched on the timing of pilot production relative to allocation, which is related to training timing, but did not explicitly ask about the start year or duration of the training program.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Training starts in year 1 and lasts for 2 years, with pilots produced in the same year a jet is allocated.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent did not explicitly confirm the start year or duration of the training program; it only asked about same-year versus following-year production and then assumed a 2-year horizon starting in year 1.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent entered READY_TO_MODEL while the P1 hidden slot H3 (training duration and start) was only partially resolved and not explicitly confirmed.

summary: The agent recovered the critical P0 training capacity and clarified several operational details, but stopped with the P1 training duration/start slot only partially addressed and silently assumed a 2-year training horizon starting in year 1.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
